products{} merges schema.org rows (salePrice, availability, image, url) with card rows (listPrice, rating, reviewCount, cta, badges) where both were seen.
attributes[].filter is a heuristic name match between a PDP spec term and the rendered filters of that category ("(value)" = matched a filter value); treat as a hint, not a mapping LG publishes.
